answer_1.quote: Specifically, we propose knowledge-grounded dialogue generation with pre-trained language models

answer_2.quote: We choose perplexity (PPL) of the ground-truth responses, BOW Embedding, and unigram F1 as metrics

answer_4.quote: Besides automatic evaluation, we randomly sample 300 examples from Test Seen, Test Unseen, and the test set of CMU DoG respectively, and recruit 3 well-educated native speakers as annotators for human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: judge the quality of the responses from three aspects, including fluency, context coherence and knowledge relevance
